entries.note: full water surface reduced to the lite one-texture recipe: scene/base sample x prebaked fresnel + constant sun highlight; reflection, normal map and light loop dropped.

def_policy.treatment: sign-expansion literals (-8192, 2, -1, -2) are folded into TEV selectors; out-of-range scalars such as -0.5/0.04/1.8 and the normal-blur constants are dropped with the original expression. Nothing is clamped: the lite plan consumes material constant c0 and uses only in-range selectors.
